title: A J Lucas Group Ltd - proposed acquisition of Mitchell Drilling Corporation Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: A J Lucas proposes to acquire the Australian operations of Mitchell Drilling.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the national markets for the supply of drilling services (excluding gas and oil, but not coal seam gas).
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition would result in little or no increase in concentration in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: 1. the presence of competing drilling service providers would pose a competitive constraint on the merged entity; 2. barriers to entry and expansion for drilling services were found to be relatively low; and 3. customers could readily switch to a competing provider of drilling services at little cost.
